lines.zh: 我在河湾的浅水里摆尾。
lines.en: I sweep my tail in the river bend.
I'm only half a block long, tiny.
Weeds slide over my back.
I drift a short way with the current.
My shadow sways on the sand.
Cretaceous water still smells the same.
I swim along the mud.
I go round a sunken root.
I swim slowly, saving effort.
A school of my kind turns by the bank.
The current carries me along.
I pause on the shallows.
A flick of my tail lifts a little mud.
I slip into a stone gap.

lines.zh: 我的鳞很细，几乎看不见。
lines.en: My scales are fine, almost invisible.
I hold still in the weeds.
Something sounds on the surface.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥，颜色跟泥一样。
lines.en: I match the mud I lie on.
The water's warm; I'm lazy.
A little sand got in my mouth.
My gills move once.
A leaf floats past.
I spread out by the stone.
In the river shallows, I hide.

lines.zh: 我沉到更深一点的地方。
lines.en: I sink a little deeper.
The light on the surface trembles.
Your shadow covers the water.
I swim by your feet.
I'm too small for you to see clearly.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，我沉下去。
lines.en: When you bend, I sink.
I'm not a fish worth catching.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴碰了一下你的靴子。
lines.en: My tail touches your boot.
Step back and the water clears.
I watch you from a stone gap.
I have muddied the swamp water.

lines.zh: 三点生命，被拍得直打转。
lines.en: Three health, and the blow spins me around.
I press into the mud and go still.
That cost me half my life.
I press to the mud, still.
I swim off a little.
I can't work the water.
I've risen again.

lines.zh: 三滴血的身子，经不起几下。
lines.en: Three points of life doesn't take many hits.
An insect has fallen in.
I can eat those crumbs.
I rise slowly.
What you dropped is very small.
My little mouth opens and the bait is gone.
I drift after it.
I wait for it to sink.
Hold still; the water will sway.
The shock tilted me.
The current pushes me into your leg.
I dive into the weeds at once.
The mud rises; I can't see.
I hit a stone and bounced.
That much impact is big for me.
The water settles again.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你也要撞一下。
lines.en: I'm this small, and you still had to bump me.
Another one is behind the stone.
We lie along the mud side by side.
Her markings are darker than mine.
We sweep our tails together.
The weeds hide us.
She swims off; I follow.
We circle half a turn.
Her fin touches mine.
The water's light falls on her.
We slip into the same crevice.
I take a small piece in my mouth.
It's harder than I am.
Something settled on the sand.
It is empty inside, turn it over.
I push it under a stone.
I'll keep it to nibble.
Whatever drops into the water is mine.

lines.zh: 这么小的嘴，也得叼点回去。
lines.en: Small mouth, but I still haul something home.
Something small is moving in the water.
I turn around.
It's bigger than me, but slow.
I approach along the mud.
The weeds cover me.
It's three inches from me.
My mud colour hides me.
I'm ready to bite.
A shadow falls from the bank.
I look up; the surface is moving.
I swim after it.
Its mud cloud hides it from me.
I come round the side.
My tail beats faster.
It stops by the weeds.
One ripple and it'll bolt.
I wait for it to turn.
Three hit points, and all of it is this mouth.
I wait by the stone.
It hasn't gone far.
One flick throws me off.

lines.zh: 尾一摆，我撞完就钻回水草。
lines.en: With a flick of my tail I dart back into the weeds.
A small splash, but a quick one.

lines.zh: 半格长的小鱼，撞你脚踝。
lines.en: A half-block fish bumps your ankle.
My teeth are small; they'll do.
I tore off a small piece.
It flicked away.
I can't keep up.
I go back under the stone.
I'm still chewing slowly.
A new shadow appears in the shallows.
The water just covers my back.
This is a Cretaceous river.
One sweep of my tail steadies me.
The mud's soft; good.
Others of my kind are near.
The surface light stings.
I swim slowly inward.
I hear something on the bank.
I sink to the bottom first.
A weed brushes me.
I start working along the bend.

lines.zh: 我从水里被甩到岸上，乱跳。
lines.en: I'm flung onto the bank, thrashing.
The water's too fast; I roll over.

lines.zh: 炸响把水推开，我也被推了。
lines.en: The blast shoves the water, and me.
Something sharp pierces me.
The water stops obeying me.
I'm fading fast.

lines.zh: 电顺着水过来，我全身僵了。
lines.en: Current comes through the water; I stiffen.
No water; I keep falling.
